items.title: Multi-Photo Posts Are Back
items.subtitle: Posts with several photos show their gallery again instead of a reddit.com link with 0 photos.

items.title: Search Without an API Key
items.subtitle: API-Key-Free post and subreddit search work again, and All Posts (r/all) loads.

items.title: Fewer Rate Limits
items.subtitle: API-Key-Free accounts send fewer Reddit requests from link previews and the Inbox.

items.title: Your Start Page Again
items.subtitle: Apollo opens your chosen feed at launch again; Restore Reading Session is now opt-in under Posts & Feeds.

items.title: Straight to the Reply
items.subtitle: Tapping an Inbox reply opens right on the comment, without the jump and glide.

items.title: Fixes Across the App
items.subtitle: A crash on rate-limited posts, grid icons after updates, interactive posts, Duo galleries and iPad Layout.
